search.label: Search open questions
search.placeholder: Search by number, question or answer

notices.text: What only the authority can answer, and on which a rule of a report rests. Until a question is answered the rule is unverified: the report says so when it is filed. Send the questions, write down who asked and when, and record the answer here.

question.text: In virkestoff.mengde, is the amount the amount of the product or of the active substance? What does styrke multiply?

affects.text: Sea-lice report: the amount of an active substance (virkestoff.mengde, coverage R03)

question.text: How is a land research site (annen produksjon, § 3 l) classified, and which duties follow?
Is Arctic char "laksefisk" for the lice duty (lakselusforskriften § 2)?
Does the 7th, or the Tuesday, shift when it falls on a weekend or a holiday? Which year applies to a week that crosses 1 January?

affects.text: Deadlines that fall on a weekend or a holiday, and the week-year (C10)

question.text: Definitions of FORBEHANDLING, BADEBEHANDLING and ANNEN_BEHANDLING: is an injection ANNEN_BEHANDLING, is a medicated feed FORBEHANDLING?

affects.text: Sea-lice report: the type of a treatment (R04)

question.text: Settefisk: what is the month-end count of a unit emptied during the month, and may one karId appear twice for two species?

affects.text: Smolt report: a unit emptied in the month, and two species in one tank (R07)

question.text: Rensefisk: where do fish delivered out of the company or sent to slaughter go (antallFlyttetUt or antallKanIkkeGjøresRedeFor)? Is the feed the cleaner-fish batches only, or all feed of the unit?

affects.text: Cleaner-fish report: fish delivered out, and the feed (R10, R11)

question.text: Is a farm accepted as the reporter of a planned slaughter, and is the kilo basis round or gutted weight? Does the weekday mean the slaughter day?

affects.text: Planned slaughter: who reports, and the kilo basis (R14)

question.text: Are the driftsplan and the lakselusforskriften § 4 plan filed only in Altinn 3, or also through the API? Is a late 2027-28 plan still accepted, and what is the consequence?

affects.text: Driftsplan and the lice coordination plan (R16, R17)

question.text: Are the monthly biomass report, the land yearly stock and the escape notice still filed through Altinn, or through an API only? Where is the escape form now?

affects.text: Monthly biomass, yearly stock of a land site and the escape notice (R20, R21, R24)

question.text: The annual report on cleaner-fish broodstock (stamfisk): form, deadline and channel.
Does the Statsforvalter annual report apply to our permit and county, and by when?

affects.text: The county report of a land site with a discharge permit (R31)
